business_summary.text: Indosolar Limited, a Waaree group company, manufactures and trades solar photovoltaic modules at its Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh factory, which began commercial operations on July 11, 2024.

operating_notes.text: The company has one reportable segment, Manufacturing & Trading of Solar Photovoltaic Modules, per Ind AS 108.
Deferred tax assets (net) of ₹6,163.51 lakh were recognised in the quarter ended June 30, 2025 on probable future taxable profits.
FY26 operating cash flow was ₹78.37 Cr against EBITDA of ₹270.75 Cr, with trade receivables absorbing ₹204.09 Cr.
On September 23, 2026, the Board approved the draft Scheme of Amalgamation of Indosolar Limited into Waaree Energies Limited under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.
